Card.description: Container card for content sections. Use for forms/content boxes, NOT for page headers.

Tabs.description: Tab navigation. Use { $bindState } on value for active tab binding.

Accordion.description: Collapsible sections. Items as [{title, content}]. Type 'single' (default) or 'multiple'.

Collapsible.description: Collapsible section with trigger. Children render inside.

Dialog.description: Modal dialog. Set openPath to a boolean state path. Use setState to toggle.

Drawer.description: Bottom sheet drawer. Set openPath to a boolean state path. Use setState to toggle.

Table.description: Data table. columns: header labels. rows: 2D array of cell strings, e.g. [["Alice","admin"],["Bob","user"]].

Image.description: Image component. Renders an img tag when src is provided, otherwise a placeholder.

Tooltip.description: Hover tooltip. Shows content on hover over text.

Popover.description: Popover that appears on click of trigger.

Input.description: Text input field. Use { $bindState } on value for two-way binding. Use checks for validation (e.g. required, email, minLength). validateOn controls timing (default: blur).

Textarea.description: Multi-line text input. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: blur).

Select.description: Dropdown select input. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).

Checkbox.description: Checkbox input. Use { $bindState } on checked for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).

Radio.description: Radio button group. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).

Switch.description: Toggle switch. Use { $bindState } on checked for binding. Use checks for validation. validateOn controls timing (default: change).

Slider.description: Range slider input. Use { $bindState } on value for binding.

Button.description: Clickable button. Bind on.press for handler.

Link.description: Anchor link. Bind on.press for click handler.

DropdownMenu.description: Dropdown menu with trigger button and selectable items. Use { $bindState } on value for selected item binding.

Toggle.description: Toggle button. Use { $bindState } on pressed for state binding.

ToggleGroup.description: Group of toggle buttons. Type 'single' (default) or 'multiple'. Use { $bindState } on value.

ButtonGroup.description: Segmented button group. Use { $bindState } on selected for selected value.

Pagination.description: Page navigation. Use { $bindState } on page for current page number.
